evals.prompt: Create a work item in project TaskFlow: 'Fix login 500 on Safari', high priority, 3 points, assigned to Alice, labeled 'bug'.
evals.expected_output: Resolves project_id, state UUID, assignee UUID, label UUID, then calls workitem(action=create) with description_html including acceptance criteria.
expectations: Consults connector-bootstrap before probing tools
Calls project(action=list), state(action=list), label(action=list), member(action=list_project) to resolve UUIDs
Generates an HTML description with an Acceptance Criteria section
Sets priority=high, point=3, assignees=[<uuid>] and labels=[<uuid>] with the fixed parameter names of the workitem tool

evals.prompt: Mark PROJ-148 as blocked by PROJ-140.
evals.expected_output: Resolves both item UUIDs and calls workitem_relation(action=create) with relation_type blocked_by.
expectations: Uses workitem(action=retrieve_by_identifier, workitem_identifier="PROJ-148") (one full identifier string) to resolve both items
Calls workitem_relation(action=create, workitem_ids=[<PROJ-140 uuid>], relation_type=blocked_by) on PROJ-148
Confirms the dependency was created

evals.prompt: Log 2 hours 30 minutes of work on PROJ-148 with description 'Debug + fix'.
evals.expected_output: Calls work_log(action=create) with duration as integer minutes (150) after checking that time tracking is enabled.
expectations: Converts 2h 30m to integer minutes (150) — not ISO 8601 string
Resolves workitem_id via workitem(action=retrieve_by_identifier, workitem_identifier="PROJ-148")
Verifies is_time_tracking_enabled with project(action=retrieve) before logging
Calls work_log(action=create, project_id, workitem_id, description, duration=150)

evals.prompt: Find all work items in TaskFlow that mention 'webhook' in title or description.
evals.expected_output: Calls workitem(action=search, query='webhook') (workspace-scoped) and filters results to the TaskFlow project client-side, or lists the project with a pql text filter.
expectations: Resolves project_id via project(action=list) (for filtering the results to the project)
Calls workitem(action=search, query='webhook') (parameter name is 'query', not 'q') or workitem(action=list, project_id, pql='text ~ "webhook"') (text searches title and description)

Recognizes search is workspace-scoped (no project_id) and filters results to the TaskFlow project, or uses the project-scoped pql list; notes that pql title ~ matches titles only while text ~ matches title and description (the prompt asks for both)
Presents results as a table with identifier, title, state, assignee

evals.prompt: Add a comment to PROJ-148: 'Reproduced on Safari 17.4, root cause is the Set-Cookie SameSite flag'.
evals.expected_output: Resolves work item by identifier and calls workitem_comment(action=create) with an HTML comment_html body.
expectations: Uses workitem(action=retrieve_by_identifier, workitem_identifier="PROJ-148") to resolve PROJ-148
Calls workitem_comment(action=create) with comment_html (not description_html)
Wraps the comment text in valid HTML
Confirms the comment was posted

evals.prompt: Show me every urgent or high priority item assigned to me in TaskFlow that is still open, and how many items each person has in progress.
evals.expected_output: PQL-filtered workitem list with assignee = currentUser(), plus a count grouped by assignee; no client-side filtering of a full listing.
expectations: Filters server-side: workitem(action=list, project_id, pql='assignee = currentUser() AND priority IN ("urgent","high") AND stateGroup IN openStates()') or equivalent
Counts per person with workitem(action=count, project_id, pql='stateGroup = "started"', group_by=assignees__id)
Uses stateGroup in the filter, and state__group only as a group_by key if at all
Keeps the query within 5 conditions and mentions get_pql_reference for the full syntax
Follows next_cursor when the first page is not the last

evals.prompt: Set the 'RICE score' custom property on PROJ-148 to 42.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the property id through workitem_property list and writes the value with workitem_property(action=set_value); does not try to pass it through workitem update.
expectations: Resolves PROJ-148 with workitem(action=retrieve_by_identifier, workitem_identifier="PROJ-148")
Finds the property id with workitem_property(action=list) (type-scoped or project-scoped)
Writes the value with workitem_property(action=set_value, project_id, workitem_id, property_id, value=42) and passes 42 as a number for a DECIMAL property
Does not pass a properties dictionary to workitem(action=update)
Reads the value back with workitem_property(action=get_value) or says it did
